question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
How much did you enjoy seeing $ZOE stand up to Jessica?
options: I was ready to see this!
I could have lived without it.

question_options.question: Have you ever been in a long-distance relationship?

labels: Stop using it as a punishment!

nodes.text: $ZOE smiles and hands cupcakes out to passers-by.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Cupcakes! Cupcakes for free!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Don't mind if I do!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Cupcakes! Cupcakes! Come and get them while they're fluffy!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Heh. Cupcakes with a face on them... Surprisingly adorable.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Cupcakes! Megan, do you want one?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I don't know if I can support this kind of...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's chocolate with white buttercream frosting...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Sold!
In no time, $ZOE and Keith hand out all the cupcakes.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Way to step it up out there, $ZOE. I didn't think you were going to be able to hand one to Megan...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who's really going to complain about a free cupcake?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Good point.
Jessica stops by the door to check on their progress.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Wow, $ZOE, if there's anything you know, it's cupcakes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's true!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I knew you'd be able to get rid of them! You single-handedly gave them all out!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Hey, she wasn't the only one doing her job. It's not like I was just enjoying the sun out here.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Shut up, Keith. Everyone knows you fake tan.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Hey! No one says that...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: They don't have to... I can see where the tanner ends and the real Keith begins.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Ouch.
Jessica turns back to $ZOE.
$ZOE runs out with the other cheerleaders, waving to the crowd as the others tumble behind her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Go, Twin Branches, go!
$ZOE does a cartwheel, and the students cheer!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Go, Twin Branches, go!
When the basketball players come out, they cheer $ZOE on and high-five her as they run onto the court.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Yeah! I'm so pumped!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Go, Twin Branches!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Whoo!
Throughout the entire night, $ZOE keeps the crowd's energy up...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoo hoo!
Until at last, the game ends!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: And with the final score of 48 to 42, Twin Branches wins!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoo!
The cheerleaders head off the court into the locker room. As they do, they pat $ZOE on the back.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You looked like a real animal out there!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I couldn't have done a better job myself...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That means a lot, Jill.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm glad I did well... But I still smell like feet!
$ZOE heads into the locker room.
$ZOE has failed.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You will?! Great!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, hold on. Wait, what if I think I don't want to do it later?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Then don't think! Besides, no take-backsies! Don't you know Girl Code Rule Number 44?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Trust me, you won't regret this...
A few weeks later...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I'm happy to announce that your President for the new school year is...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: `Ben Kale!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ben Kale![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You've got to be kidding me!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aw man...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Go, Ben, go!
Ben takes the stage and waves out to the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hello, Twin Branches! It's an honor to be your President. I'd like to take this moment to thank everyone in my campaign.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: To my wonderful girlfriend, Jessica Blaire. Her tireless efforts have earned her the title of First Girlfriend of the campus!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, they have!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Now I'd like to talk about the changes I'm bringing to this school next year...
As Ben talks, $ZOE approaches Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So, uh, Jessica... Now that Ben's won... I wanted to talk to you about some ideas I had for our cheer routine...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Excuse me? Last time I checked `I'm` still Cheer Captain, and `I` choose our cheer routines.
nodes.text_bbcode: Excuse me? Last time I checked [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] still Cheer Captain, and [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] choose our cheer routines.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, you said that when Ben became President, I'd get some `perks...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, you said that when Ben became President, I'd get some [color=#3b78e2][i]perks...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Who told you that?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You did!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Are you questioning me?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Watch who you're talking to, $ZOE. I'm the First Girlfriend at school now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh yeah? What can you really do?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Actually, quite a bit.
Ben steps in between them.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What's going on here?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Ben!` She's a traitor, and she's trying to upset the fragile balance of the cheerleading squad!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ben![/i][/color] She's a traitor, and she's trying to upset the fragile balance of the cheerleading squad!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Do something about it! Stop her!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Secret service!
Immediately, several students dressed in black swarm around $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Yes, POTS?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We really need a better acronym for President of the School...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: What is your command, sir?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Escort this girl into maximum security detention... Where she'll have time to think about her crimes!
As they begin dragging her away, $ZOE struggles.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You can't do this! It's against my rights!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You don't have any rights!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I regret this! I regret endorsing Ben! I never liked him!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Good thing it's too late for that...
Uh-oh! Looks like Jessica's let the power go to her head! And it is kind of $ZOE's fault...
Sometimes people shouldn't get what they want... Especially Jessica! Try again and see if you can make a better choice next time around!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Like I said, I don't know that much about what he stands for.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All I've really heard is his name coming up over and over again from you.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nothing's changed since yesterday, Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nothing...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Except the smell of feet.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Keep the costume, $ZOE. I have a feeling you might `need` it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Keep the costume, $ZOE. I have a feeling you might [color=#3b78e2][i]need[/i][/color] it.

nodes.text: Jessica storms away.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, now I `definitely` don't want to support Ben...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, now I [color=#3b78e2][i]definitely[/i][/color] don't want to support Ben...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But if I tell Jessica that...
$ZOE eyes the mascot costume.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't want to be the mascot for the rest of my high school life!
$ZOE runs out with the other cheerleaders...
As they start their cheer, she starts shoving into them!
Nicole is bounced to the side, drawing a laugh from the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: $ZOE?! What are you doing?
The girls twirling around her stumble as $ZOE pushes and shoves her way through in her bulky mascot costume!
All the girls try to avoid $ZOE, moving in strange circles and arcs that don't match the cheerful music blasting throughout the gym.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Agh! I can't avoid her!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: No way! Don't stand near me!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: She's getting in my way!
When the students in the crowd start pointing at the dodging cheerleaders, Jessica turns back and hisses at all of them.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Get back into formation!
Nicole, Jill, and Maria try to cheer in their places again, but $ZOE chases them away from the center.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE, get off! Go away!
From across the room, Wilson's cheerleaders start jeering and laughing...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Ha ha... Wow... Your school might have changed names, but you guys are every bit as pathetic as ever!
Soon, the entire gym is laughing!
When the basketball players come out on court, they avoid looking at the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Come on, guys. Let's just focus on winning the game...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is a disaster...
After the game, the cheerleaders glare angrily at $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Next time you feel like doing whatever `that` was, do it somewhere else!
nodes.text_bbcode: Next time you feel like doing whatever [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] was, do it somewhere else!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: That was awful! You're a disgrace to the mascot costume.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now everyone hates me, `and` I'm pretty sure I smell like feet...
nodes.text_bbcode: Now everyone hates me, [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] I'm pretty sure I smell like feet...

nodes.text: She heads into the locker room with the rest of the cheerleaders.
$ZOE forcefully shoves away from the table, causing the plates and silverware to rattle.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE? What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I just remembered I have to do something at home. `Right now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I... I just remembered I have to do something at home. [color=#3b78e2][i]Right now.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm so sorry!
$ZOE walks quickly outside and down the block.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sniff... Sniff...
A few moments later, Howard catches up to her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE! Are you... Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sniff... All this talk about graduation and you leaving...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It made me freak out... Sniff...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I couldn't stand to listen to it anymore, so I ran.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Tell you parents I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I will.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But right now, talk to me. What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I have to keep it together... I don't want to lose it in front of Howard's family.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, that's great news, Howard. Kingston is a very good school. I'll keep my fingers crossed.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks, $ZOE. We'll see how I do on my interview with them next week.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Besides, I'm not even sure I want to go.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Just make sure you consider it.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: We can figure it out when we get there. In the meantime...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Kay and Kel, since you've had so much dessert, why don't you two do the dishes?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Aww...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yay, bubbles!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess I should head home. Thank you for dinner.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: You're very welcome. Goodnight, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll walk her out.
Howard walks $ZOE to the door.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, what's wrong? You didn't seem like yourself at the end.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, you're going off to college... Soon, you'll be moving out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All this talk about you going away scares me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't want things to change...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They won't change that much...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What if you move across the country? What then?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We'll figure out how to be together. No matter where I go.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How do `you` feel about everything?
nodes.text_bbcode: How do [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] feel about everything?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, I'm sad. I don't want to leave Twin Branches...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But at the same time, it's exciting. College will be something interesting and new.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If we went to the same college, it wouldn't matter how long we were apart. We'd still end up together.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, I have an idea... I'm going to Centerscore University later this week for a campus tour.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why don't you come with me? We can check out the campus... Eat some college food... Crash some parties...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You mean, see how cool college is compared to high school?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, at the very least we could time exactly how far apart we would be from each other.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Trust me, everything's going to be just fine. Like it is now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Except that everything `isn't` fine now...
nodes.text_bbcode: Except that everything [color=#3b78e2][i]isn't[/i][/color] fine now...

nodes.text: Howard wraps his arms around her. They stay that way for long while...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I love you, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love you too.
The next day after school, $ZOE and the other cheerleaders gather in the Wilson High gym right before a basketball game.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh, these losers are so lucky they have a gym.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Girls, huddle!
The cheerleaders crowd around Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Listen, I want to switch things up `temporarily... `
nodes.text_bbcode: Listen, I want to switch things up [color=#3b78e2][i]temporarily... [/i][/color]

nodes.text: Jessica nods at $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I wonder what that means...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nicole, you've been cheering from the front row for the last few weeks. Why don't we change that?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What? But... I'm always in front!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I know, and times are changing. Everyone should have a turn...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So that's why I want someone new and special to stand in the front row...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is she going to pick me?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Someone who really deserves it...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Jill!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Jill![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: What? But I...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: This is great! I'm usually the mascot!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: But where am I supposed to go?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Don't tell me I have to wear that smelly old suit!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You can take $ZOE's place in the back.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...But what about me?
Jessica gives $ZOE a wide smile.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I thought you might `temporarily` enjoy being mascot.
nodes.text_bbcode: I thought you might [color=#3b78e2][i]temporarily[/i][/color] enjoy being mascot.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh really?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's just for one night...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Unless you decide you `really` love it...
nodes.text_bbcode: Unless you decide you [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] love it...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's what you always wanted to do, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She's making me mascot because I wouldn't endorse Ben!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's time to go out and cheer! Have fun!
She winks at $ZOE and runs onto the court.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll show her... I'll try to be the best mascot ever!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Which school is it?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Kingston University. It's located on the East Coast, somewhere near New York.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: New York? That's... That's all the way across the country!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: And it'd be difficult to visit. The plane flight's at least `six hours...`
nodes.text_bbcode: And it'd be difficult to visit. The plane flight's at least [color=#3b78e2][i]six hours...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE takes in a slow, steady breath as Howard's family talks around her.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: You never know, Howard. Depending on which college you get into, you might be seeing them more than you think.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What... What colleges have you applied to, Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I sent out a few to colleges in the area... Centerscore U, for one.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I've also been hearing back from `other schools...`
nodes.text_bbcode: And I've also been hearing back from [color=#e23b3b][i]other schools...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Other schools?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Right! Tell her about the one that might offer you a full scholarship, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, uh, it's not a sure bet, but there's one college that wants me to join their football team.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Isn't that great?

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: It'd make up for those years we spent paying for all your football equipment.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: And it's a prestigious institution. You'd do well, even if you are far away.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Far away?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I mean, I don't really know what he stands for...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It'd be weird to endorse him, you know?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, just `so weird.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, just [color=#3b78e2][i]so weird.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry I couldn't give you a definite answer...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm `sure` you `are.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]sure[/i][/color] you [color=#3b78e2][i]are.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hopefully, it doesn't affect my chances of cheering in the front or... Eventually getting my own routine?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Ha.` Maybe it will, maybe it will.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ha.[/i][/color] Maybe it will, maybe it will.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Did you just say that `twice?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Did you just say that [color=#3b78e2][i]twice?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Jessica clears her throat and gives $ZOE a wan smile.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm only offering this `temporarily...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm only offering this [color=#3b78e2][i]temporarily...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So be sure to make up your mind soon, $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Before I have to do it for you.
Jessica stomps away.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow, she was really upset...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I feel... I feel like I just made a `huge` mistake...
nodes.text_bbcode: I feel... I feel like I just made a [color=#3b78e2][i]huge[/i][/color] mistake...

nodes.text: $ZOE tries to hand out cupcakes to passers-by, but freaks them out instead!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hidey-ho, partner!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, the Wild West theme was `so` four weeks ago.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, yeah, the Wild West theme was [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] four weeks ago.

nodes.text: Carson walks by, and Keith shakes his head.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Hidey-ho

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Normal! Right! I can do that!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hello there, young Megan! Might I interest your mouth in a baked good?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: You talk weird, pom-pom. Get out of my face.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Maybe I should handle customer interactions. Why don't you get us a refill on cupcakes?
$ZOE hurries inside and grabs another tray of cupcakes. On her way out, she trips and falls, cupcake tray and all!
She tumbles into Nicole and Jill, and they all go down in a huge heap!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Gross! I have buttercream on my new jacket! Now that sketchy waiter will `never` hit on me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Gross! I have buttercream on my new jacket! Now that sketchy waiter will [color=#3b78e2][i]never[/i][/color] hit on me!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I wanted a cupcake in me, not `on` me....
nodes.text_bbcode: I wanted a cupcake in me, not [color=#3b78e2][i]on[/i][/color] me....

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I wanted both!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry... Sorry, guys!
Jessica comes up to them.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And who, exactly, is responsible for this catastrophe?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: She was the one who tripped!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: $ZOE's a walking disaster! She did this! Now all the stickers are covered with frosting!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Is this true?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I may have tripped... But it was totally an accident!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I think it's brilliant!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I wish the rest of you had been so creative! $ZOE's the only one being original!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't be so shy, $ZOE. Scratch and sniff stickers? Brilliant! Now everyone can sniff Ben!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ew?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, I like it. $ZOE, you're promoted to management! You can sit around with me and watch everyone else pass out stickers next time!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: As for the rest of you... Laundry duty will go a lot easier with more people, won't it?!
The rest of the cheerleaders give $ZOE a dirty look.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Nice going, $ZOE.
They walk away in a huff. Jessica hangs back to help $ZOE up.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't worry about them. $ZOE, can we talk for a minute?
Jessica pushes $ZOE into a booth.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just be careful, $ZOE. I've been down this path before.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Doing everything just to please the Head Cheerleader. Well, look where it's gotten me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You mean, into a sport you actually excel at and dating a guy you love and trust?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That was `after` cheerleading, $ZOE.
nodes.text_bbcode: That was [color=#3b78e2][i]after[/i][/color] cheerleading, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't want her to play you. I'm just looking out for you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's my job to tell you what might happen. Besides, I have a feeling this is going to get a lot worse before it gets better.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Jessica's going absolutely nuts trying to get votes for Ben... And you're well-liked by most of the school.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I am?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know if that's true...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Watch this.
Sam turns, scans the crowd, and plucks Erik out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Erik... Who are you voting for President?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh gosh! For President? That's a lot of pressure! I don't know! Whoever $ZOE is voting for, I guess!
Sam lets him go.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That was... Random.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But, surprisingly, proved my point. Whoever you vote for, people will follow.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And something tells me Jessica's going to try to exploit you as much as she can...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You really think so?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know. I don't enjoy this kind of thing. Girl politics. That's why I left cheerleading.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just... Just watch your back, okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, Sam. Thanks.
$ZOE and Sam part ways, Sam to the swimming center, $ZOE to the diner.
In front of the diner, $ZOE and the other cheerleaders assemble. Jessica clears her throat.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: All right, cheerleaders! We're here for one thing and one thing only...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: To hit on that sketchy waiter with the face tattoo?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No! To get Ben's name out there!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Aww... Again? We've been doing this forever.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Which is how long you're going to be doing mascot duty if you don't shut your blue piehole.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ooo! Can we get blueberry pie?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I shouldn't have to tell you that your school needs you!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And that means we're handing everyone everything! Stickers! Cupcakes! Buttons! `Everything!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And that means we're handing everyone everything! Stickers! Cupcakes! Buttons! [color=#3b78e2][i]Everything![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No one leaves this diner without something that has Ben's face on it!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nicole and Amanda, you're in charge of buttons.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I love buttons!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Get used to giving them away...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Goodbye, buttons...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Maria and Jill, you're on sticker duty...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE and Keith, you're handing out Ben-cakes!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Really?
Jessica hands everyone their campaign props.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: There had better not be a cupcake, sticker, or button between you all when we're done.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I have a great idea... Why don't we give an award to the group that hands out the most campaign stuff?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I have an even better idea...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why don't I give out laundry duty to the group that has the most stuff in their hands at the end of the hour?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Gulp!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Now go!
Keith and $ZOE stand just outside the door, cupcakes at the ready.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is it me, or is Jessica way more... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Insane than usual? Yeah, she is. She's made me fetch her `four` cappuccinos in the last twenty minutes!
nodes.text_bbcode: Insane than usual? Yeah, she is. She's made me fetch her [color=#e23b3b][i]four[/i][/color] cappuccinos in the last twenty minutes!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoa. Caffeine overdose!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: The latest poll numbers say that the other candidates have some niche votes. When Ben's not sweeping, Jessica's not happy.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I think we're going to be riding this wave for a while.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who are you going to vote for?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Depends on who's asking. If it's Jessica... You know I'm voting for Ben!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What if `I'm` asking?
nodes.text_bbcode: What if [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] asking?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I don't know... I always figured I'd vote for whoever you vote for.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You would?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Yeah... I trust you... I think other people do too.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam was right!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: In fact, if you voted for someone, I bet `everyone` would...
nodes.text_bbcode: In fact, if you voted for someone, I bet [color=#e23b3b][i]everyone[/i][/color] would...

nodes.text: Jessica storms over.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Keith! Stop yapping over there! Start handing things out!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Why don't you give everyone that sugary smile you do so well? You know, that sicky-sweet one I just want to punch?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You'll pass out so many more cupcakes that way!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, uh... Okay...
Keith makes eye contact with $ZOE as Jessica flounces away.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: `Someone's` on her good side...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Someone's[/i][/color] on her good side...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Apparently!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Get those cupcakes out there!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoops... Better concentrate on these cupcakes!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You sure aren't acting like it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What am I supposed to do about it? She's the Head Cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If I want to stay a cheerleader, then I have to listen to her, don't I?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, at least Jessica's not slipping a fast one by you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, really? She hasn

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well... She always did that...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And you haven

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She said it stood for

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And what about that life-sized cardboard cutout of Ben in your locker?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe I just think Ben

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE! Admit it! She

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, I'll admit... The cardboard cutout is super-creepy. I feel like its eyes follow me when I walk around...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But so what?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She's getting free labor out of you guys. Without even trying. And you're just going along with her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What else am I supposed to do? She's Head Cheerleader!

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, you were `lucky` to be mascot, $ZOE.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, you were [color=#3b78e2][i]lucky[/i][/color] to be mascot, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: First Ben, now, you...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I can't have everyone suddenly disobeying me!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Except in your case, I don't have to be nice!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE, you're off the squad!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Are you done yet? Because I have half a mind to kick you off...
Before Jessica can say another word, some of the other cheerleaders speak up!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I totally agree with $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I had to do some time in the costume, and it was the most miserable time of my life!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I hate to admit it, but what $ZOE's been saying makes sense...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: See, Jessica? They agree with `me.`
nodes.text_bbcode: See, Jessica? They agree with [color=#3b78e2][i]me.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Jessica narrows her eyes and glares at every cheerleader who's spoken up in agreement of $ZOE's defense...
$ZOE looks imploringly at the other girls.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on, don't any of you want to say something? Does anyone agree with me?
Though some of the cheerleaders meet her eyes, no one steps forward.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, okay, are you done now? I have half a mind to kick you off the squad entirely.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Fine. But you don't want to do that.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And why's that?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because even though the other girls aren't saying anything, I `know` they agree with me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Because even though the other girls aren't saying anything, I [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] they agree with me.

nodes.text: Jessica narrows her eyes and glares at the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You can't keep using it to threaten us with anymore.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's just not fair.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We should be allowed to disagree with you without fear of wearing a smelly cheese costume!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Hey! I have a say too, and I say I'm never going back!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: See what you're doing, $ZOE? You're destroying the proper order of the cheerleading pyramid with your attitude!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't be the only one that hates the costume!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... You need to make Jill go back to it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, there's another thing!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not going to be the mascot anymore. And I'm going to stand up and tell you that you should...

options.label: Stop using it as a punishment!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Real `big` news there, $ZOE.
nodes.text_bbcode: Real [color=#3b78e2][i]big[/i][/color] news there, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `No one` likes being mascot.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]No one[/i][/color] likes being mascot.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And `no one` likes to be ordered around or forced to do something they don't want to do!
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#3b78e2][i]no one[/i][/color] likes to be ordered around or forced to do something they don't want to do!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, too bad! I make decisions for the team, and you have to listen to them. Now if that's all...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Really? That's what you want to tell me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love cheerleading because it's fun and it makes me feel active, and we get a lot of attention because we're cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But you're taking all the fun out of it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're making it all political, and you're getting in our faces and making us do these things that have nothing to do with cheerleading!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're ruining it! Not just for me... For everyone!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We aren't your personal slaves!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: If that's all...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... I hate being mascot?
The other cheerleaders look over to see what's going on, but $ZOE ignores them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not going to stand by while you order me around.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's not an `order.` It's just a `very strong suggestion.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's not an [color=#3b78e2][i]order.[/i][/color] It's just a [color=#3b78e2][i]very strong suggestion.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You can make whatever `choices` you want, but you already know what the `consequences` are...
nodes.text_bbcode: You can make whatever [color=#3b78e2][i]choices[/i][/color] you want, but you already know what the [color=#3b78e2][i]consequences[/i][/color] are...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh really?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I have something I have to get off my chest...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So I'm not way into the election like you are, but that doesn't mean I should just carelessly toss my endorsement around!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know if Ben is the candidate I want...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I'll make my own choice when the time comes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And it'll have nothing to do with you!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So what's the big deal?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Just support him and get it over with...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And then I don't have to make you regret it...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We can both be happy!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: See? You have nothing to say to that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I kind of ran away from Howard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He was talking about how excited he was about college... About the quad, and the classes, and the parties...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And the girls?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, not that... Well, not directly anyway.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How can I compete with all that? How am I going to stay in his life?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And with everything going on, I haven't been able to talk to him about all the drama with cheerleading...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: When is there `not` drama in cheerleading?
nodes.text_bbcode: When is there [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] drama in cheerleading?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is worse. Jessica's demoted me. I'm the team mascot... It's humiliating! And I haven't done anything wrong!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's just because she wants something from me, and if I don't give it to her, I'll be a mascot for the rest of my high school life!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah... Jessica's a piece of work...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It seems like everything I loved about my life is just disappearing through my fingers.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I can't do anything to stop it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whoa.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know, right?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, I can't help you with the Howard stuff... He's going away. You'll join him eventually.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It'll fix itself.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But as for Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whatever she's making you do... Don't do it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Easy for you to say...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, it is. Because I don't take crap from other people.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And neither should you. It's your life.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If you keep following her orders, she's going to ruin it for you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It doesn't sound like anyone else on that sorry team is going to help you, so you're on your own.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Stand up, or lose everything you love doing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Colt...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. Just don't go around repeating what I said.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now, I think there's someone here who wants to see you...
Colt points at the doorway where Howard is standing, dripping.
Howard rushes to their table.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Colt, I got your text... Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You told him that you found me?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I had to.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, I was looking everywhere! Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I feel a little better... Sorry about running off.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Come on, let's just go home...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'd like that...
At cheerleading the next day...
Jessica takes $ZOE aside.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE... Listen, I was thinking about the way I acted yesterday...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And I may have been a little harsh. It's just that I really want Ben to have this Presidency...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: As his Campaign Manager, there's just so much that's expected of me...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: All the other candidates are gaining ground, Ben's losing votes... I'm under so much pressure, I just snapped!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You can understand that, can't you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... I can.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I forgive you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Great!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Now that's settled... Can you please endorse Ben for me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Jessica, I already told you that I'm not sure...
Jessica narrows her eyes.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh. This again.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Look, you don't really care about the Presidential election. It's not really your thing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, yeah, but...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So why not Ben?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She only apologized to get my vote!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It doesn't really matter who you throw your weight behind, does it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's nothing.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nothing. As in, I just found you wandering around campus in the rain, looking like you've been sucker-punched for no reason.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You girls always say it's nothing when it's `something.` The bigger the nothing, the bigger the something.
nodes.text_bbcode: You girls always say it's nothing when it's [color=#e23b3b][i]something.[/i][/color] The bigger the nothing, the bigger the something.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So maybe you don't want to talk to me. But don't ignore yourself.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't want to sound stupid.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You know the crappy part about getting better at being a boyfriend? I actually have to listen to girls now.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So try me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Everything is going wrong!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't mind telling you, but what I'm going to say is going to be so stupid...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I promise not to tell you if it is...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know, you've really changed. What happened?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Love. Stupid, cheesy love.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So spit it out already. You'll probably feel better.
$ZOE can feel tears welling in her eyes, and instead of turning to Howard...
She runs from him.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE! Wait!
$ZOE runs and runs until her legs can't carry her anymore. She collapses on a bench.
There's a low rumble in the sky, and suddenly, $ZOE feels droplets of water on her face.
They're light at first, but start to grow heavier and heavier.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's raining!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sniff... Sniff...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know where I am... What am I going to do?
That's when she sees the bright beam of a single headlight in the darkness. Soon, she sees a motorcycle. It stops near her.
A shadowy figure hops off and steps into the path of the beam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Colt?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: $ZOE? What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I could ask you the same question...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's stupid to talk out here in the rain. Climb on. I'll give you a ride.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: On a motorcycle?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No, in the car that I also brought with me.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Of course on my motorcycle. You want to walk?
$ZOE can feel the rain starting to seep into her clothes. Cautiously, $ZOE straps a helmet on and climbs on.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hang on!
With a loud roar, Colt wheels his motorcycle around in a large arc and rushes down the road towards a large cluster of buildings...
A short time later...
$ZOE and Colt sit down in the university cafeteria.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So... Want to tell me what you're doing here?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Only if you go first.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I... Uh... Heard there was a huge sorority party, and I... Wanted to hit on some girls?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You don't care about other girls. You're dating Denni now.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, fine. I'm... I'm checking this college thing out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I know I'm not graduating for at least a year, but... I'm checking college out. It seems okay. I don't get all the hype.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Isn't it a big deal? I didn't think you were going to college...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, neither did I... Until Denni brought it up. Now it's all in her head... She wants me to apply myself now, so that she can eventually join me at a good college a couple years from now.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But honestly, I just don't know if I can get in...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So, I've answered your question. Now you answer mine.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What are you doing here? Alone, without Vanilla? Aren't you two joined at the hip?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It'll be harder than ever to stay connected to each other's lives.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I barely know what's going on in your head now.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's not true!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Most of the stuff I just told you is stuff I just thought of now.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're the first person I've ever told about anything like this!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't know you wanted to take up biology... Or join the Greek system...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How am I going to know you when you're actually away?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We'll `talk`, $ZOE. All the time.
nodes.text_bbcode: We'll [color=#e23b3b][i]talk[/i][/color], $ZOE. All the time.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Will that be enough to keep us going?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What if it isn't, Howard? What if this is the thing that breaks up?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They'll be everywhere, Howard! All pretty and perky and... You know... Experienced!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, how could you think I'd forget about you that easily?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I love you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So you say now! But what happens when you're here without me, and there's another girl, and...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Our relationship still managed to survive when `one` of us was interested in `someone else!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Our relationship still managed to survive when [color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] of us was interested in [color=#e23b3b][i]someone else![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If you're talking about Matteo...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Of course I'm talking about Matteo! He came between us. We survived.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So you're saying you can go off with another girl, and we'll be fine?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No! What I'm saying is that there's `no` other girl. I love `you!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No! What I'm saying is that there's [color=#e23b3b][i]no[/i][/color] other girl. I love [color=#e23b3b][i]you![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But what if that's not enough, Howard? What if it's `not enough?`
nodes.text_bbcode: But what if that's not enough, Howard? What if it's [color=#3b78e2][i]not enough?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE turns and runs from him.
The next afternoon, Howard takes $ZOE around Centerscore U.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, this is nice.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is the main quad where everyone hangs out. They hold festivals and host live bands and stuff like that.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If this is the school I end up at, I could be passing through here every day...
Despite the sadness within her, $ZOE puts on her best smile.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's cool.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So... Here's a question. What are you going to study?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's what my parents want to know. I'm not sure honestly.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess that's why you have general eduation classes the first year or so. To figure out what you want.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But if I had to choose right now...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Science. Biology, probably.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Science? Really?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You don't think I can do it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't know you were interested! Mr. Russell catches you sleeping in his class all the time!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Because we're talking about genetics or whatever.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I aced the animal section!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And come on... I know everything there is to know about ducks.
Howard playfully nudges her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know... Don't you have to study a lot for science? I thought you didn't like studying all that much.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure, High School Howard doesn't. But maybe `College Howard` will `enjoy` studying. It could be his new hobby.
nodes.text_bbcode: Sure, High School Howard doesn't. But maybe [color=#e23b3b][i]College Howard[/i][/color] will [color=#e23b3b][i]enjoy[/i][/color] studying. It could be his new hobby.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh-huh.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just hope College Howard isn't `too` different...
nodes.text_bbcode: I just hope College Howard isn't [color=#3b78e2][i]too[/i][/color] different...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, we're coming up on Greek row. This is where all the fraternities are...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you thinking of turning Greek?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'd seriously consider it. It could be fun... My friend, $USR, hangs out at MAN a lot... It's a lot of fun.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So I hear... Mainly from Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She would know. I can totally picture her joining OMG her first year.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: OMG?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You know, the sorority. They're always hanging out around MAN house and throwing awesome parties...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They hold the best social events on campus.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Great...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's bad enough Howard is going away... But he's going to a place where he'll meet a ton of girls!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, I know this is hard. But talk to me. What are you feeling?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm just worried about...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So $ZOE... You look totes awesome! Have you been working out?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, no more than usual... But thanks.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You look so good, you should be at the center of the cheer formation next time.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are... Are you sure? I've been in the back of every routine since you became Cheer Captain.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE, you're the youngest member of the squad. I can't give you a leg-up. The girls who are older should get their chance in the spotlight.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But things are changing. `You're` getting old!
nodes.text_bbcode: But things are changing. [color=#3b78e2][i]You're[/i][/color] getting old!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...  Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's nearly your time to shine. What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Jessica, that'd be awesome, but...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you okay? You haven't been this nice to me since... Well, since never really...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I might have the teensiest favor to ask...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What can I help you with?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, $ZOE... Ben is really hoping to become President.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah. You've been campaigning for him really hard. Most of the school is going to vote for him.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But sadly, 'most of the school' is not enough for him to win. We need a clean sweep, a majority.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I really hope you get it. You're working so hard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: My mom always says 'Think big, dream high'...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Believe me, I'm thinking `big.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Believe me, I'm thinking [color=#3b78e2][i]big.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Which brings me to you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're still popular. You were Homecoming Queen after all, and even though there are a lot of rumors about what you did to Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You mean, about what `you` did to Taylor?
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean, about what [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] did to Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's not how everyone else remembers it.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But that's all behind us now. What's important is that... People still like you!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And if you tell people that `you` like `Ben`, `they` will like Ben!
nodes.text_bbcode: And if you tell people that [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] like [color=#3b78e2][i]Ben[/i][/color], [color=#3b78e2][i]they[/i][/color] will like Ben!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You want me to endorse Ben?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't act so shocked! You've been handing out his cupcakes all day!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're practically halfway there! A public announcement that you wanted Ben to win is just the next step!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I don't know if I want Ben to win...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Of course you do! You know, if Ben wins, things would get a lot better for you!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE, honestly, I always felt that you could be, like, my manicured right hand... My backup dancer... My fashionable second-in-command...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Think about all the perks! I could bring you to parties, borrow all your clothes, give you makeovers...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure... That's nice, but...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And you know, I've been real busy lately. It's getting hard to think of new choreography every other week.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I could use some help thinking up a whole new routine...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You mean... I could use my own choreography?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'd help, of course, but it'd mainly be to supervise. Once Ben wins, it'd just be `so` hard to be First Girlfriend `and` Cheer Captain...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'd help, of course, but it'd mainly be to supervise. Once Ben wins, it'd just be [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] hard to be First Girlfriend [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] Cheer Captain...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Huh...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So will you endorse him?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam was right! She's really pushing this on me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But what should I tell her?
Inside, $ZOE sheds her mascot costume and gets into clean clothes.
Jessica stops by.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ew, it smells like sweaty socks in here! No offense, $ZOE, but you reek!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That mascot costume should really be `washed.`
nodes.text_bbcode: That mascot costume should really be [color=#3b78e2][i]washed.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'd do that, but then it wouldn't be half as much fun to put people in.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you want, Jessica?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I wanted to talk to you about the mascot position...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You did such a good job out there...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm thinking of giving you the position full-time!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: With you out there for every sports game we go to, you'll inspire everyone so much!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What's wrong? You don't look very happy about that...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You were awful! I almost kicked you off the squad right then and there...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But don't worry. I figured out a solution...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's that?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You just need to practice more! If you play mascot three or four times a week for every sports game, you'll get better in no time!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What's wrong? You don't look very happy about that...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: To be honest, Jessica... I don't want to be the mascot.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's too bad. It looks like it'll be a great fit for you...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Unless...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Unless what?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, there's a possibility my boyfriend's going to be President, and if that happens, I won't be able to devote all my time to cheerleading...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Someone would have to take my place...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're talking about being Head Cheerleader?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No, of course not! `I'm` Head Cheerleader. But you could take my spot in front. That's better than mascot, isn't it?
nodes.text_bbcode: No, of course not! [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] Head Cheerleader. But you could take my spot in front. That's better than mascot, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Most things are...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Great! Then it's settled... You'll support Ben!

options.label: I'm still not sure about that...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... What?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You heard me. Turn in your pom-poms and cartwheel yourself out of the park!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're out!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But... But... I can't be out!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love being a cheerleader!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's too bad. Maybe you should have thought about that before you opened your big mouth!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Now go away! You're not one of us anymore!
$ZOE sadly leaves the cheerleaders behind.
The next day after school...
$ZOE meets Sam at a restaurant to talk about her future.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just... I just don't know who I am anymore!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, $ZOE... It's okay. The first couple days after the transition are rough.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But you'll get through it. We're going to help you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We?
Taylor walks through the door and sits down next to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor! What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I just heard you got kicked off. I thought I needed to be here.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You see... Sam and I started the Cheerleader Displacement Program for cheerleaders who are cut from the squad.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It takes you through the four stages of patheticness.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are those?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The first stage of patheticness is grieving.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We brought you a pillow. Go ahead and cry into it. You lost your good status today.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If you think it'll help...
$ZOE takes the pillow and holds it up to her face...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sniffle... Sniffle....

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sniffle!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't believe... Sniffle... I lost everything...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If I lost cheerleading... Sniffle... I could lose school...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's not true... But let it all out...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, if I lose school... Sniffle... I could lose Howard...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If I lose Howard... Well, you know...
A couple hours later...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And if I lose my socks... Sniffle... I could lose my shoes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And if I lose my shoes... Sniffle... Sniffle...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If you lose your shoes, it won't matter!
$ZOE sobs harder into the pillow...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Taylor... `
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Taylor... [/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sam, this is getting worse, not better! I can't watch this anymore... It's `too` pathetic!
nodes.text_bbcode: Sam, this is getting worse, not better! I can't watch this anymore... It's [color=#3b78e2][i]too[/i][/color] pathetic!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We're making her do something else!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Step two... Exploring a lot of new hobbies and interests!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Like archery!
Sam hands $ZOE a bow and arrow.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Go ahead, $ZOE. Shoot at that clay kitty.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't shoot at a clay kitty...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't want to hurt it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But you won't... It's clay. It doesn't have any feelings...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That you know of!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, all right. Fine. What about the clay bunny over there then?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's worse!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It looks like all their archery targets are cute, fuzzy animals...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I won't harm them! I refuse!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can already tell you now that archery or any other sport isn't going to do it...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't think archery is going to cut it...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, right, moving on then...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The third stage is playing Ogres 'N' Elves...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't remember this stage...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Some of us might have stopped prematurely at step two.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, I don't think $ZOE's going to enjoy playing a `lame` game of...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I don't think $ZOE's going to enjoy playing a [color=#3b78e2][i]lame[/i][/color] game of...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey, don't judge... This step really worked for me. Ogres 'N' Elves is actually kind of therapeutic...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: As soon as you figure out all your stats, pick your class and orientation, and start rolling some d20s, it gets good...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I have no idea what you just said...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh boy...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's step four of the process?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, step four looks a lot like step one. Cry into a pillow until some new way to makeover your life comes into your head!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, I stopped at step two, and Taylor stopped at step three, so this is new territory...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Great... I'll just be doomed for the rest of my life not knowing what I'm interested in or where I belong...
Oh no! Zoe's been displaced, and she's having a lot of trouble figuring out what else she wants to do!
Play again and try to make some better choices so $ZOE doesn't have to leave the cheerleading squad!

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.text: That evening...
Howard and $ZOE walk into Howard's house where a beautiful dinner has been set out!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Welcome home, you two! Find a seat. Horace and I will be there soon.
Howard and $ZOE sit down.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm really glad I'm here with you tonight. I've had a rough day.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Definitely. It sounds like you deserve a good meal right now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've just been feeling so weird about what happened with Jessica earlier...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, hopefully it was just a one-time thing...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... I'm just going to ignore it, and it'll blow over eventually...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But right now, I'm looking forward to digging in!
Howard's family joins them, and they eat dinner.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: $ZOE, we are so glad you could join us.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah! We always get the good food when you're here.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We never get dessert on normal days!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee. Thank you for inviting me over. You know how much I love your guys' chicken and broccoli dish!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Well, isn't that sweet? It is my specialty.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: It's the only thing he can cook besides grilled cheese sandwiches...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Which are also delicious, I might add.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Of course they are, dear.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Anyway, $ZOE, are you free on the weekend right after school gets out for summer break?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: That's when we were going to host Howard's graduation party.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, right... Graduation is coming up soon...
$ZOE feels a heavy weight on her heart.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, yeah... I should be free.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Oh good! We're going to have it at the country club. It'll be fancy since this is a big deal!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: And here I never thought I would see Howard become a man.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: It's so strange to think of my little Howard growing up.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: It feels like just yesterday he was Kay and Kel's age.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh wow...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Does that mean tomorrow we can drive a car?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: I want to drive a car!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh man, I'm glad I'll be `gone` when you two holy terrors start driving...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh man, I'm glad I'll be [color=#e23b3b][i]gone[/i][/color] when you two holy terrors start driving...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'Gone'?
Suddenly, $ZOE feels like the air has been sucked out of the room.
$ZOE takes in a slow, steady breath as Howard's family talks around her.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: You never know, Howard. Depending on which college you get into, you might be seeing them more than you think.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What... What colleges have you applied to, Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I sent out a few to colleges in the area... Centerscore U, for one.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I've also been hearing back from `other schools...`
nodes.text_bbcode: And I've also been hearing back from [color=#e23b3b][i]other schools...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Other schools?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Right! Tell her about the one that might offer you a full scholarship, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, uh, it's not a sure bet, but there's one college that wants me to join their football team.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Isn't that great?

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: It'd make up for those years we spent paying for all your football equipment.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: And it's a prestigious institution. You'd do well, even if you are far away.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Far away?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Which school is it?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Kingston University. It's located on the East Coast, somewhere near New York.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: New York? That's... That's all the way across the country!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: And it'd be difficult to visit. The plane flight's at least `six hours...`
nodes.text_bbcode: And it'd be difficult to visit. The plane flight's at least [color=#3b78e2][i]six hours...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE has failed.
