nodes.text: The next day after school, $ZOE and the other cheerleaders gather in the Wilson High gym right before a basketball game.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh, these losers are so lucky they have a gym.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Girls, huddle!
The cheerleaders crowd around Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Listen, I want to switch things up `temporarily... `
nodes.text_bbcode: Listen, I want to switch things up [color=#3b78e2][i]temporarily... [/i][/color]

nodes.text: Jessica nods at $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I wonder what that means...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nicole, you've been cheering from the front row for the last few weeks. Why don't we change that?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What? But... I'm always in front!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I know, and times are changing. Everyone should have a turn...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So that's why I want someone new and special to stand in the front row...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is she going to pick me?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Someone who really deserves it...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Jill!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Jill![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: What? But I...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: This is great! I'm usually the mascot!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: But where am I supposed to go?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Don't tell me I have to wear that smelly old suit!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You can take $ZOE's place in the back.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...But what about me?
Jessica gives $ZOE a wide smile.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I thought you might `temporarily` enjoy being mascot.
nodes.text_bbcode: I thought you might [color=#3b78e2][i]temporarily[/i][/color] enjoy being mascot.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh really?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's just for one night...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Unless you decide you `really` love it...
nodes.text_bbcode: Unless you decide you [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] love it...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's what you always wanted to do, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She's making me mascot because I wouldn't endorse Ben!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's time to go out and cheer! Have fun!
She winks at $ZOE and runs onto the court.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll show her... I'll try to be the best mascot ever!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't want things to change...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They won't change that much...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What if you move across the country? What then?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We'll figure out how to be together. No matter where I go.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How do `you` feel about everything?
nodes.text_bbcode: How do [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] feel about everything?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, I'm sad. I don't want to leave Twin Branches...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But at the same time, it's exciting. College will be something interesting and new.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If we went to the same college, it wouldn't matter how long we were apart. We'd still end up together.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, I have an idea... I'm going to Centerscore University later this week for a campus tour.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why don't you come with me? We can check out the campus... Eat some college food... Crash some parties...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You mean, see how cool college is compared to high school?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, at the very least we could time exactly how far apart we would be from each other.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Trust me, everything's going to be just fine. Like it is now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Except that everything `isn't` fine now...
nodes.text_bbcode: Except that everything [color=#3b78e2][i]isn't[/i][/color] fine now...

nodes.text: Howard wraps his arms around her. They stay that way for long while...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I love you, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love you too.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I have to keep it together... I don't want to lose it in front of Howard's family.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, that's great news, Howard. Kingston is a very good school. I'll keep my fingers crossed.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks, $ZOE. We'll see how I do on my interview with them next week.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Besides, I'm not even sure I want to go.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Just make sure you consider it.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: We can figure it out when we get there. In the meantime...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Kay and Kel, since you've had so much dessert, why don't you two do the dishes?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Aww...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yay, bubbles!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess I should head home. Thank you for dinner.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: You're very welcome. Goodnight, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll walk her out.
Howard walks $ZOE to the door.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, what's wrong? You didn't seem like yourself at the end.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, you're going off to college... Soon, you'll be moving out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All this talk about you going away scares me.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE, honestly, I always felt that you could be, like, my manicured right hand... My backup dancer... My fashionable second-in-command...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Think about all the perks! I could bring you to parties, borrow all your clothes, give you makeovers...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure... That's nice, but...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And you know, I've been real busy lately. It's getting hard to think of new choreography every other week.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I could use some help thinking up a whole new routine...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You mean... I could use my own choreography?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'd help, of course, but it'd mainly be to supervise. Once Ben wins, it'd just be `so` hard to be First Girlfriend `and` Cheer Captain...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'd help, of course, but it'd mainly be to supervise. Once Ben wins, it'd just be [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] hard to be First Girlfriend [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] Cheer Captain...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Huh...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So will you endorse him?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam was right! She's really pushing this on me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But what should I tell her?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: To be honest, Jessica... I don't want to be the mascot.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's too bad. It looks like it'll be a great fit for you...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Unless...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Unless what?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, there's a possibility my boyfriend's going to be President, and if that happens, I won't be able to devote all my time to cheerleading...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Someone would have to take my place...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're talking about being Head Cheerleader?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No, of course not! `I'm` Head Cheerleader. But you could take my spot in front. That's better than mascot, isn't it?
nodes.text_bbcode: No, of course not! [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] Head Cheerleader. But you could take my spot in front. That's better than mascot, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Most things are...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Great! Then it's settled... You'll support Ben!

options.label: I'm still not sure about that...

nodes.text: Her gaze finally lands hard on $ZOE, and $ZOE meets her eyes, the tension growing between them.
Then suddenly... Jessica laughs.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE, don't be silly...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I wasn't `threatening` you with the mascot costume. I was just giving Jill a break!
nodes.text_bbcode: I wasn't [color=#3b78e2][i]threatening[/i][/color] you with the mascot costume. I was just giving Jill a break!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You were?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Of course! The mascot costume isn't punishment! Who do you think I am? Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sheesh. You try to do someone a favor, and that's how they repay you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE, you're a cheerleader, not an animal.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But all those things you said about endorsing Ben...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Endorsing Ben, schmendorsing Ben. Who cares? I just wanted your bid, and I was hoping you'd help me out.
Jessica laughs, and this prompts some nervous laughter from the other girls.
Suddenly, $ZOE knows exactly what's happened.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She's being nice to me because she can't kick me off the team. She knows the other girls support me, and if she dumps me, she'll risk alienating them!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's really funny, Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I know.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So I guess this means we'll have to find a new mascot.
Jessica's eye twitches.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah... A `new` mascot. Nicole, Maria, get on that.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... A [color=#3b78e2][i]new[/i][/color] mascot. Nicole, Maria, get on that.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Right away!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Okay!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Other than that, you girls are free to go. I have some planning to do...
Jessica brushes past $ZOE, lowering her voice.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This may have worked `one` time, but you'd better stay in line... Or I'll find a way to make you stay there!
nodes.text_bbcode: This may have worked [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] time, but you'd better stay in line... Or I'll find a way to make you stay there!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Just kidding!
Jessica gives $ZOE a very hard pat on the back and stalks off.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I did it! I stood up to Jessica! That means, I don't have to be mascot, and I can stay on the team!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But Jessica did look furious... I just hope I didn't start something I can't handle...
Congratulations! You helped $ZOE navigate through some very tough spots!
Not only did you help her calm down about Howard going to college, but you also helped her stand up to Jessica!
No more mascot costumes for you `or` her!
nodes.text_bbcode: No more mascot costumes for you [b]or[/b] her!

nodes.text: Let's just hope what $ZOE has done doesn't have too many `bad` consequences...
nodes.text_bbcode: Let's just hope what $ZOE has done doesn't have too many [b]bad[/b] consequences...

nodes.text: The next afternoon, Howard takes $ZOE around Centerscore U.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, this is nice.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is the main quad where everyone hangs out. They hold festivals and host live bands and stuff like that.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If this is the school I end up at, I could be passing through here every day...
Despite the sadness within her, $ZOE puts on her best smile.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's cool.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So... Here's a question. What are you going to study?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's what my parents want to know. I'm not sure honestly.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess that's why you have general eduation classes the first year or so. To figure out what you want.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But if I had to choose right now...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Science. Biology, probably.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Science? Really?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You don't think I can do it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't know you were interested! Mr. Russell catches you sleeping in his class all the time!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Because we're talking about genetics or whatever.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I aced the animal section!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And come on... I know everything there is to know about ducks.
Howard playfully nudges her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know... Don't you have to study a lot for science? I thought you didn't like studying all that much.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure, High School Howard doesn't. But maybe `College Howard` will `enjoy` studying. It could be his new hobby.
nodes.text_bbcode: Sure, High School Howard doesn't. But maybe [color=#e23b3b][i]College Howard[/i][/color] will [color=#e23b3b][i]enjoy[/i][/color] studying. It could be his new hobby.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh-huh.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just hope College Howard isn't `too` different...
nodes.text_bbcode: I just hope College Howard isn't [color=#3b78e2][i]too[/i][/color] different...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, we're coming up on Greek row. This is where all the fraternities are...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you thinking of turning Greek?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'd seriously consider it. It could be fun... My friend, $USR, hangs out at MAN a lot... It's a lot of fun.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So I hear... Mainly from Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She would know. I can totally picture her joining OMG her first year.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: OMG?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You know, the sorority. They're always hanging out around MAN house and throwing awesome parties...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They hold the best social events on campus.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Great...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's bad enough Howard is going away... But he's going to a place where he'll meet a ton of girls!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, I know this is hard. But talk to me. What are you feeling?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm just worried about...

nodes.text: After school one day, Sam and $ZOE are walking towards their after school programs.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So I heard Nick got a lot of praise for his work with the newspaper article.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah. Apparently he's good at taking pictures. Who knew?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's wrong? You're making a sad face. And you know how I feel about sad faces.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They make me sad too!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well... I'm glad Nick is really committing to photography...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I know `I'm` the one that told him to get his own hobby and have his own life...
nodes.text_bbcode: And I know [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] the one that told him to get his own hobby and have his own life...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I'm kind of starting to regret it now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You don't approve of photography?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's not the photography I have a problem with. It's the subject matter.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Am I the only one who thinks it's weird that he's decided to become Sara's campaign manager?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, they did seem to hit it off as friends. Sometimes you just get along with someone else.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe... But he could stand to be less happy about it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I guess I should let him have friends, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, Sam. Friends are good.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Anyway, what about you? Why are you heading this way? Don't the cheerleaders practice in the park?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm actually meeting them at the diner.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So you guys eat now? So much has changed since I was on the team...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha, no... It's not like that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: A lot of Twin Branches students go to the diner after class since the school closed...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Jessica wants us to hang out there and hand out things for Ben's Presidential campaign.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh-oh. And so it begins...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just mean... It's gross how she's making the cheerleaders do all her dirty work.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Can't you see she's taking advantage of you?
